description: Use when someone asks what their organisation must do about data protection, or how to start. The steps that apply to its profile under the Swiss FADP, the GDPR and the AI Act, in the order EasyLPD's path follows (six stages), each with the articles of each law, its weight, why it matters and the template that carries it out with the link to its page. With answers from assessment_questions, the steps already done are left out.

ai.description: Uses AI systems in its work (AI assistants, chatbots, automated screening or scoring).

answers.description: Optional answers by question id: steps answered yes or na are left out.

ch.description: Established in Switzerland, or processing data of people in Switzerland.

euEstablishment.description: Has an establishment (branch, subsidiary, office) in the EU/EEA.

euMonitoring.description: Monitors the behaviour of people in the EU/EEA (online tracking, profiling).

euOffer.description: Offers goods or services to people in the EU/EEA.

lang.description: Language of the answer: it, de, fr or en.

name: action_plan
title: Data protection action plan for an organisation
